title: Corruption cops look at United List politicians posing on combine harvester
summary_full: The Corruption Prevention and Combating Bureau (KNAB) will launch an investigation into whether the activities last Friday of representatives of the United List (AS) party alliance, including Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs, complied with the requirements of the Pre-election Campaign Law, the bureau told the LETA news agency.
